data.fixed_clause: Submission of this employment application and participation in the preliminary evaluation stages constitutes the applicant's irrevocable authorization for the company to process, retain, and utilize all submitted information for the purposes for which it was collected, except in specific cases set out in the law, with such authorization remaining binding and not subject to subsequent revocation.
